items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: I think Joe Harris said that too.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's McGee. I don't know what his father meant. Joseph Jamon. Oh yes. Harold Dejean. Do you remember the drummer? Yeah, that's McGee. I don't know. He's four years old. That's right. I think Joe Harris said that too. About when was that? Do you remember what year that would be? This was around 31.

1931. That late, was it? And you say you played trombone too with this same group? No, not with that group. With this fella here, this trumpet player. Where did he get that name T-boy? Do you remember?
